notes.title: V1.08 Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44296249/ec787bd36d08bccf00ad10d875826b4553b9fe68.jpg

1.Optimized the latter part of the game - Swimsuit and Hot Spring events can now view all four characters' stories at once.
2.Upon completing all stories (including endings), H scenes can choose not to use condoms.
3.Upon completing all stories (including endings), the "Release" event in the church will display 6 H events at once on any given day (except Sunday).
4.After purchasing the schedule watch, it can be used via the inventory or the upper left corner of the screen (next to the date).
5.Optimized tutorial content.
6.Fixed known errors, typos, and animations that do not affect the game process.

We apologize for the frequent updates in the past few days due to continuous corrections and optimizations. We hope players can enjoy the game without pressure. If you have any ideas, please let us know.

Lastly, we have received many suggestions for additional content from players, and we will carefully consider them. Thank you for your support!

--------------------------------------------------
